normalized verified identity cannot participate through another account
concurrent formatted identity claims create exactly one session
different verified people are independent and pending identity is not treated as proof
leading zero and lowercase check-digit variants cannot renew a verified slot

paced automation at 500 ms persists review and cannot liquidate ranking or credits
manual false-positive clearance persists actor/reason and allows original finalizer

legacy verified identity collisions are reviewed after profile approval changes
direct finalizer re-scans an old finalizing tournament and cannot bypass review
anon cannot read identity/evidence or invoke privileged controls
authenticated cannot read identity/evidence or invoke privileged controls
